purpose.summary: This is a batch report/print program for a Japanese medical billing system (JMA ORCA). It generates a list of patients eligible for a local public expense subsidy (Fukui/medical expense assistance program), covering receipt types 191, 193, 194, 196, and 198. It reads indexed billing files, aggregates claim data, and produces formatted printed output.

notable_features: No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — database access via CALL to external subprograms
Heavy use of COPY statements for record layouts and common areas (CPCOMMONPRT.INC, CPCOMMONSHELL.INC, CPSK1001.INC, etc.)
Japanese-language comments encoded in latin-1 (actually Shift-JIS/EUC-JP rendered as latin-1)
Extensive revision history in comments spanning 2007–2013
OCCURS table for parameter handling (TBL-PARA-OCC OCCURS 100)
60 CALL statements indicating heavy use of external subprogram library
verdict.notes: The file is encoded as latin-1 but the Japanese comments are almost certainly Shift-JIS or EUC-JP; the garbled characters are an artifact of the encoding mismatch. The program is part of the open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt software suite. Source is truncated at 16000 chars but the structure and purpose are clear from what is visible. No COMP-3 usage detected despite being a financial/billing program — arithmetic fields use plain PIC 9.
